stories.Explanation: Three major rating agencies upgraded Hartford's financial strength and debt ratings in 2025
stories.Description: A.M. Best (July), S&P (August), and Moody's (October) all upgraded Hartford's ratings in 2025, reflecting improved performance and capital resiliency

History.event: A.M. Best upgraded senior debt to 'a' from 'a-'
S&P upgraded core subsidiaries to 'AA-' from 'A+'
Moody's upgraded P&C subsidiaries to 'Aa3' from 'A1'
